_doc: NGUON DUY NHAT cua design token cho ca web va app dien thoai.
Sua o day roi chay `npm run sinh_token` — dung sua tay hai tep duoc sinh ra:
`npm test` co mot test doi chieu hai tep do voi tep nay, quen sinh lai la test do.
Trich tu bo Compose Boltuix App Template (Color.kt / Shape.kt / Type.kt) da giai nen va doi chieu.

_ly_do_khong_dung_poppins: Spec v2 ghi font Poppins. Da kiem: ca 8 tep Poppins trong kit VA ban chinh thuc tren
google/fonts deu chi co 471 glyph va THIEU 88/133 ky tu tieng Viet — mat o u va toan bo
khoi U+1EA0-1EF9 (a a a a a e e i o o o u u u...). Dung Poppins thi hau het nhan tieng Viet
bi tut sang font du phong, chu bi lan font ngay giua mot tu.
Be Vietnam Pro: sans hinh hoc, phu 133/133 ky tu Viet, dau duoc thiet ke rieng cho tieng Viet,
hep hon Montserrat nen vua o bang. Giay phep SIL OFL 1.1 — phat hanh kem duoc.

bo_goc._ghi_chu: Kit goc Shape.kt = 4dp. Mockup CEO duyet ~13px. Da chot 12px: lam tron tu 13, chia het cho thang 4dp nen the long trong the van deu.

diem_ngat._ghi_chu: F2: kiem thu bat buoc o <=768 (dien thoai/tablet doc) va >=1280 (desktop).

bong._ghi_chu: Chi web dung. App dien thoai dung vien 1px thay bong cho nhat quan hai he dieu hanh.

y_nghia_mau._ghi_chu: Thang mau ngu nghia cho trang thai ngay cong — dung chung web va app.

nguon_mau._ghi_chu: Doi chieu token spec v2 <-> gia tri thuc trong theme va ly do lech (neu co).
nguon_mau.brand_4285F4: Khop Color.kt: `val ColorScheme.composeThemeColor get() = Color(0xFF4285f4)`. Giu nguyen lam mau nhan dien.
chinh_chi_de_TO_MANG: #4285F4 tren nen trang chi dat 3.56:1 — KHONG du 4.5:1 cho chu, va chu trang tren no cung
chi 3.56:1. Nen `chinh` chi dung cho mang to khong co chu de len: thanh tien do, cot bieu do,
gach chan tab, vien nhan manh, chip co chu mau dam.
Chu / lien ket / nhan nut dac dung `chinh_dam` (#1967D2 — 5.17:1 tren trang, dung ca cho
nen nut dac voi chu trang). Day la cach Material xu ly: blue-500 to mang, blue-700 cho chu.
nguon_mau.brand_che_do_toi: #4285F4 tren nen #1B1F26 chi dat 3.4:1 — khong du cho chu. Che do toi dung #8AB4F8 (blue-300), cung ho mau.
nguon_mau.accent_EB4658: Spec ghi #EB4658. Tren nen trang chi 3.6:1 — khong du cho chu/nut phu. Che do sang dung #C1273A cung ho; che do toi #FF8A95.
nguon_mau.trang_thai_iOS: Cap mau spec liet ke la (dam cho che do toi | dam hon cho che do sang). Da giu dung tinh than do, chi nang nhung gia tri khong dat 4.5:1.
